messages:
emma: Quick callout0: need a decision for the 3-day sprint: (1) ship critical embed reliability fix that impacts paying tenants, or (2) polish onboarding modal which may lift new-user activation. Which do we take?

noah: Reliability. Paying customers are flagging it.

ravi: +1. Repro in staging, seems like an edge-null in payload parsing. I can spike a fix today.

zoe: Data: modal polish ups new-user CTR by ~2.4% but low overall ROI. Embed bug is causing timeouts for enterprise traffic.

emma: If we pick reliability we should scope it to a single PR and avoid refactors. We want a canary in 24h.

cassie: Support has 5 open tickets tied to the embed issue; customers asked for ETA yesterday. Recommend we take the fix now.

noah: Proposed plan: 1) reproduce + add failing test 2) add defensive parsing + retry window 3) integration test 4) canary rollout. Estimate 2 dev days.

ravi: I'll add the test and the minimal defensive check. If CI is flaky I may need an extra half-day.

emma: Zoe, can you schedule the modal polish into "wave-b" and add acceptance criteria so it doesn't get lost?

zoe: Done. I've created ticket and added ACs. Will slot for next sprint.

cassie: Support comms: I'll prepare a short note for affected tenants once canary is green.

ci-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for commit f9a2b1 to cluster-2.

noah: Action items recap: Ravi -> PR + tests; Zoe -> move polish to Wave B; Cassie -> customer note; Emma -> update roadmap board. Target: verify canary within 12 hours of deploy.

emma: Thanks team. One more ask: capture a short postmortem if rollback happens.

ravi: Will do. Opening branch hotfix/embed-parse-guard now and adding WIP PR.

noah: I'll pair on integration test tomorrow AM.

ci-bot: Build passed. Canary queued.

emma: Great. Closing decision: reliability-first. We'll re-evaluate polish after canary. :thumbsup:
